PM Modi visits Seychelles, focusing on maritime cooperation and ties

Prime Minister Narendra Modi has begun a visit to Seychelles, coinciding with the nation's Golden Jubilee National Day celebrations. The visit aims to strengthen bilateral maritime cooperation between India and Seychelles. During the visit, PM Modi highlighted the strong and long-lasting nature of India-Seychelles relations.
